stories.excerpt: Sierra Space recently conducted successful hypervelocity impact trials at NASA’s White Sands Test Facility in Las Cruces, New Mexico, to optimize the structural integrity of Sierra Space's Large Integrated Flexible Environment (LIFE®) habitat. The goal of this NASA-supported testing was to refine a shield for the company’s expandable, flexible space station structure to make it capable of withstanding impacts from hazards on orbit. featured.title: Vulcan failure investigation focuses on ‘inadequate fuel supply’ to booster engines
featured.excerpt: United Launch Alliance said Wednesday that a preliminary review of flight data points to an inadequate supply of fuel to the Blue Origin-manufactured engines of its Vulcan rocket, rather than a problem with the engines themselves, as the reason Sunday's launch fell short of orbit with 40 Amazon Leo internet satellites aboard.
